description: This file defines the implementation of the IFactories interface within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It manages a singleton instance of IFactories, providing methods to assign, access, and check availability of the instance.

classes.name: IFactories
classes.description: An interface class for factory management within the plugin host, providing static methods to assign, access, and check the singleton instance.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Assigns a new instance to the singleton _factoriesInstance, with assertions to ensure proper state.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton _factoriesInstance, asserting it is not null.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the singleton _factoriesInstance is available (not null).
